decisions.reason: The new MOSFET topology switches the already-established 3.3V LED supply but does not change the LED supply voltage, direct data drive, or level-shifter requirement.
Changing the LED supply-switching transistors does not change the indicator board's LED count, model, package, part number, or board role.
The LED switching-transistor selection does not alter the DCDC1 configured output, target rail voltage, or compensation requirement.
A same-message MODIFY already records IRLML2402 and IRLML6402 as the addressable-LED power-switching transistors; no additional BOM update or removal is entailed.
The transistor change does not alter the monitored rails, INA3221 channels, monitor position, or 3.3V measurement coverage.
The addressable-LED switching circuit does not change any sensor-board connector, module, pinout, or sensor supply requirement.
The new LED switching transistors do not change the standalone regulator, its capacity, activation condition, shared rail load, or source-selection behavior.
The LED switching topology is internal power-control circuitry and does not change any interboard connector, pinout, or board power-distribution topology.
The source changes the separate 3.3V LED power-switching circuit; the independently controlled 5V sensor rail and its powered loads remain unchanged.
The LED supply-switching transistors do not affect the panel power-button connector, PWRON connection, or press-to-toggle behavior.
The addressable-LED switching-transistor update does not alter the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID/VSYS, or DCDC1 source topology.
The LED power-switching circuit does not change the ESP32 BOOT button, reset connection, or associated capacitance values.
